summary: Venue/track-name HUD overlay. Timer-gated: this[4] is decremented by dbl_8AFE98 each call and the function hides (returns 1) once it drops below 0. When season races data is available it resolves a venue-name string and a secondary string from the race database via StringKeyedLinkedListSearch/DataEntryAccessor on off_5D4AF8 and off_5D4AFC. The venue name is rendered at (640, 818); a decorative separator is built by copying byte_5EA438 into the buffer and appending the byte_5D4AEC character 16 times, then rendered at y = 858; the secondary string is rendered at (640, 898). All text uses UITextRenderWithScale with color 0xFFFFFF, font 2, and text-rendering results go through a string-table dedupe check (BinarySearchInStringTable) into byte_5EC4CC.

local_names.this: HUD overlay object whose float field at offset 0x10 is the display timer
local_names.v2: venue name string resolved from the race database
local_names.v10: secondary/extra string resolved from the race database
local_names.v11: one-character separator string built from byte_5D4AEC
local_names.v12: working text buffer for the rendered line
local_names.v5: x position used for the separator render (640 when a venue name was found)

operations.description: Timer hide gate: return 1 when this[4] < 0.0
Decrement display timer: this[4] = this[4] - dbl_8AFE98
SeasonRacesSectionFinder(0); when it returns 0 the venue-name branch is skipped

Resolve strings from the race database: StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(off_5D4AF8[0]) then DataEntryAccessor yields the venue name v2; StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(off_5D4AFC) then DataEntryAccessor yields the secondary string v10

Render venue name when v2 is present: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v2, byte_5EC4CC) and if matched strcpy(byte_5EC4CC, v2); sub_587DD0(v12, byte_5EC4CC, 127); then UITextRenderWithScale(v12, 640, 818, 0xFFFFFF, 2, 0, 1.0, 1.0)
Build separator character: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v11, "%c", byte_5D4AEC) formats the single separator character (format literal address held by the aC global)
Copy byte_5EA438 string into v12 until the NUL terminator
Append the separator character 16 times: strcat(v12, v11) repeated while a 16-run counter is nonzero

Render secondary string when v10 is present: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v10, byte_5EC4CC) and if matched strcpy(byte_5EC4CC, v10); sub_587DD0(v12, byte_5EC4CC, 127); then UITextRenderWithScale(v12, 640, 898, 0xFFFFFF, 2, 0, 1.0, 1.0)
Return 0 after rendering (only the timer-hide path returns 1)
